title: Steps 4-6: one coefficient level of pullback, twist and local models
statement: Fix distinct primes p,ell, a field k of characteristic p, a separated finite-type k-scheme S, a finite extension E/Q_ell, hS asserting ell invertible, tower classes c and presentations DS, DP [det-sp-tower-classes, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Fix a derived tower K on S, one positive level n+1, and integers r,s,a,b. Suppose that this single input level has cohomology in [r,s], intrinsic constructible cohomology and Tor amplitude [a,b] [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Then this single level of the actual tower pullTwist(K) has cohomology in [r-2,s-2], intrinsic constructible cohomology and Tor amplitude [a-2,b-2]. There is a LocalModel for this input-output pair over S and over every affine base open U, where input is restricted along U to S and output along P1_U to P1_S [def-sp-tower-p1-ctf-data, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. There is no hypothesis about other levels or their compatibility, and no uniform-tower or proper-image conclusion.

proof.text: Both S and P1_S are Noetherian by finite type over a field and properness of projective space. The coefficient quotient is finite. Apply finite-ring constructible derived origin to the input level, and use its exact interval assertion to keep [r,s]. Use comparison_torAmplitudeIn_iff in the actual intrinsic coordinates to reflect [a,b] along the retained origin isomorphism. Its Tor premise includes a<=b. Apply the finite-value flat constructible model theorem to obtain C with flat constructible terms, support [a,b] and Q(C) isomorphic to the antecedent.

Trivialize the finite etale Tate line and apply etale_pullback_line_flat_model to q, C and shift 2. The actual support is [a-2,b-2]. The cohomology formula with index j+2 gives [r-2,s-2]. Retain its arbitrary prescribed pulled-back locally closed finite constructible strata and the finite module values on their common trivializing covers.

Use the normalized evaluation of tower pullback and tensor, the finite Tate-line evaluation in the tower classes, and signed shift comparison to identify the actual output level with the intrinsic realization of that etale model. Exact comparison preserves cohomology and zero terms; flat ringed-topos pullback preserves flat terms. The bounded-above flat theorem gives independent K-flatness. The localized representative comparison gives pro_represents. Exact constructible comparison and the intrinsic Tor interval bridge give the stated bounds.

For an affine open U, restrict C with the unit line and shift zero, preserving support and flat constructibility. The open is Noetherian. Repeat the line construction for P1_U and shift 2. The scheme-comparison restriction square and normalized root pullback identify its realization with the restriction of the actual global output. Assemble the retained witnesses as LocalModel. This treats only this n; zero objects and empty opens use containing intervals without a nonemptiness assumption.
